# Flow reference (`nurtuo.flow/v1`)

This page is generated from the JSON Schema (`sdk/ts/flow-schema/schema/flow.v1.schema.json`) and the example flows in `examples/flows/reference/`. Field names, types and constraints are the schema's; semantic rules (ports, cycles, ...) are in [flow-validation.md](flow-validation.md). Read [concepts.md](concepts.md) first if flows, steps and ports are new to you.

Each example below is a complete flow that passes the validator (`nurtuoctl validate`); `node scripts/gen-flow-reference.mjs --validate` re-checks them.

## Flow document

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | const `"nurtuo.flow/v1"` | yes |  |
| `id` | string | yes | minLength 1 |
| `name` | string | yes | minLength 1 |
| `description` | string | no |  |
| `revision` | integer | yes | >= 0 |
| `steps` | array of step | yes | minItems 1 |
| `edges` | object | yes |  |

Root additional properties are not allowed (`additionalProperties: false`). Logic of one flow. Layout (canvas positions) is stored separately. Edges are keyed by 'stepId:port'; one outgoing edge per port.

`edges` keys must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`: the step id, a colon and the port name. Values are the id of the target step.

## Step envelope

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$` |
| `kind` | enum | yes | one of `start`, `connector`, `queue`, `map`, `script`, `message`, `setProperties`, `decision`, `branch`, `route`, `tryCatch`, `processCall`, `notify`, `stop`, `returnDocuments` |
| `label` | string | no |  |
| `config` | object | yes |  |

Step ids must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$`. `config` is validated against the per-kind schema below; unknown fields are rejected in every config.

## Step kinds

| Kind | Output ports | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [start](#start) | `default` | Trigger. |
| [connector](#connector) | `default` | Connector step shell (operation against an external system). |
| [queue](#queue) | `default` | Queue step shell (publish to a queue component). |
| [map](#map) | `default` | Map step shell; compiled to JSONata. |
| [script](#script) | `default` | Runs a sandboxed WASM script over each document. |
| [message](#message) | `default` | Sets the document body from a template. |
| [setProperties](#setproperties) | `default` | Sets document or process properties from CEL expressions. |
| [decision](#decision) | `true`, `false` | Boolean CEL condition. |
| [branch](#branch) | `1` .. `paths` | Runs paths sequentially. |
| [route](#route) | one per route `id`, then `default` | Sends documents to the first matching route. |
| [tryCatch](#trycatch) | `try`, `catch` | Runs a path and handles failures on a second path. |
| [processCall](#processcall) | `default` | Calls another flow by id. |
| [notify](#notify) | `default` | Sends a notification. |
| [stop](#stop) | none (terminal) | Ends the run. |
| [returnDocuments](#returndocuments) | none (terminal) | Returns the current documents to the caller. |

### start

Trigger.

Output ports: `default`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | enum | yes | one of `manual`, `listener`, `schedule`, `queue` |
| `connector` | string | no | minLength 1 |
| `path` | string | no |  |
| `method` | string | no |  |
| `queue` | string | no | minLength 1 |
| `cron` | string | no | minLength 1 |
| `auth` | object (listenerAuth) | no |  |
| `tls` | object (listenerTLS) | no |  |
| `insecure` | boolean | no |  |

`auth`: HTTP listener authentication. bearer: the secret as an Authorization Bearer token. apiKey: the secret in header (default X-API-Key). hmac: HMAC of the raw body, keyed with the secret, in header (default X-Signature).

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | enum | yes | one of `bearer`, `apiKey`, `hmac` |
| `secret` | string (secretRef) | yes | pattern `^secret://[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$` |
| `header` | string | no | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$` |
| `algorithm` | enum | no | one of `sha256`, `sha512` |
| `encoding` | enum | no | one of `hex`, `base64` |
| `prefix` | string | no |  |

`tls`: HTTP listener TLS (minimum TLS 1.2): PEM certificate chain and private key from secrets.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cert` | string (secretRef) | yes | pattern `^secret://[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$` |
| `key` | string (secretRef) | yes | pattern `^secret://[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$` |

- When `type` is `"listener"`: required `connector`.
- When `type` is `"queue"`: required `queue`.
- When `type` is `"schedule"`: required `cron`.
- A flow must have exactly one `start` step and it cannot have incoming edges.
- Runtime status: only `listener` with `connector` `http` and `queue` start steps are bound to push listeners by the runtime (`core/runtime/internal/listener`). `manual` and `schedule` are accepted by the schema, but nothing in the runtime fires a cron schedule yet, and other connector listeners (bridge listeners) are not built by the listener factory.
- The HTTP listener matches `path` exactly (it must start with `/`; there is no `{id}` path templating despite the `/employees/{id}` shape in `examples/flows/get-employee.flow.json`), defaults `method` to `POST`, and accepts bodies up to 1 MiB.
- HTTP listener protection is opt-in: `auth` (`bearer`, `apiKey` or `hmac`; the secret is resolved from the runtime secret store and compared in constant time; a failed check is answered `401` before the flow runs) and `tls` (PEM certificate and key from secrets, TLS 1.2 minimum). The runtime refuses to start an HTTP listener on a non-loopback `http_addr` without `auth` unless `insecure` is `true`. `auth`, `tls` and `insecure` are ignored by other start types. See [connectors/http.md](connectors/http.md#http-listener-start-step).

Example (`examples/flows/reference/start.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-start",
  "name": "Reference: start",
  "description": "HTTP listener trigger.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "listener",
        "connector": "http",
        "path": "/orders",
        "method": "POST"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "done"
  }
}
```

### connector

Connector step shell (operation against an external system).

Output ports: `default`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `connector` | string | yes | minLength 1 |
| `operation` | string | yes | minLength 1 |
| `objectType` | string | no |  |
| `connection` | string | no |  |

- `operation` is an operation name of the connector. The engine maps `GET`, `QUERY`, `CREATE`, `UPDATE`, `UPSERT` and `DELETE` (case-insensitive) to the matching contract operation type; any other value is sent as `EXECUTE` with that value as the custom type.
- `connection` selects the connection registered as `<connector>/<connection>`; if that is not registered the entry registered as `<connector>` is used.
- Per-document results: `SUCCESS` passes the document on (replaced by output documents if the connector returned any), `APPLICATION_ERROR` and `FAILURE` mark the document failed. Tracked values appear as document properties `tracked.<name>`.
- Runtime status: the `nurtuo` binary registers the native connectors `http`, `sftp`, `postgres` and `nats`. The `connection` is looked up among the connections of the deployed bundle; `secret://name` values in it are resolved from the runtime secret store, and the connection is tested at deploy time (`connection_test`). Bridge connectors cannot be configured from `runtime.yaml` yet. Verified with unit and end-to-end tests of the http connector, not against every external system.
- `postgres` takes the SQL from the input document (`{"sql": "...", "params": [...]}`), so a flow normally builds that document with a `map` or `message` step before a `postgres` `QUERY` step; `examples/flows/get-employee.flow.json` shows the shape of the flow but omits that step.
- The HTTP connector reads its per-document overrides from `http.method`, `http.path`, `http.query.*` and `http.header.*`. The HTTP listener sets `http.request.method`, `http.request.path`, `http.request.header.*` (lowercased) and `http.request.query.*` instead, so incoming request metadata is never mistaken for an override; copy what you need with `setProperties`.

Example (`examples/flows/reference/connector.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-connector",
  "name": "Reference: connector",
  "description": "Call an HTTP connector operation.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "call",
      "kind": "connector",
      "config": {
        "connector": "http",
        "operation": "GET",
        "connection": "orders-api"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "call",
    "call:default": "done"
  }
}
```

### queue

Queue step shell (publish to a queue component).

Output ports: `default`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `queue` | string | yes | minLength 1 |
| `operation` | enum | yes | one of `publish` |

- Runtime status: the schema accepts `queue` steps, but the engine has no step runner for them yet; a document reaching this step fails with code `no_runner`. Publishing to a queue from a flow is not implemented. (Starting a flow from a queue works, see `start`.)

Example (`examples/flows/reference/queue.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-queue",
  "name": "Reference: queue",
  "description": "Publish documents to a queue.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "publish",
      "kind": "queue",
      "config": {
        "queue": "orders.inbound",
        "operation": "publish"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "publish",
    "publish:default": "done"
  }
}
```

### map

Map step shell; compiled to JSONata.

Output ports: `default`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jsonata` | string | yes | minLength 1 |

- `jsonata` is a JSONata expression evaluated against the JSON payload of each document; the JSON result replaces the payload. An undefined result drops the document. A payload that is not JSON fails the document.

Example (`examples/flows/reference/map.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-map",
  "name": "Reference: map",
  "description": "Transform the JSON payload with JSONata.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "reshape",
      "kind": "map",
      "config": {
        "jsonata": "{ 'id': id, 'name': first_name & ' ' & last_name }"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "reshape",
    "reshape:default": "done"
  }
}
```

### script

Runs a sandboxed WASM script over each document.

Output ports: `default`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `script` | string | yes | minLength 1 |
| `timeoutMs` | integer | no | >= 1; <= 600000 |
| `memoryMiB` | integer | no | >= 1; <= 4096 |
| `capabilities` | array of any | no |  |

- Runs a WebAssembly module over every document in a sandbox (memory, time and output limits, capability allow-list). `script` names a registered module; `timeoutMs` (default 10000), `memoryMiB` (default 32) and `capabilities` (`clock`, `random`) are optional. Zero output documents drops the document, several replace it. A failing document gets code `script.<code>`; other documents continue. Details in [scripts.md](scripts.md).
- Runtime status: the runner is registered in the `nurtuo` binary, but modules are not yet delivered to the runtime (bundles do not carry them), so a `script` step on a deployed runtime currently fails with `script is not registered`. The step works in the engine with an in-process module registry (see the tests).

Example (`examples/flows/reference/script.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-script",
  "name": "Reference: script",
  "description": "Run a sandboxed WebAssembly module over every document.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "tidy",
      "kind": "script",
      "config": {
        "script": "normalize-names",
        "timeoutMs": 2000,
        "memoryMiB": 16,
        "capabilities": [
          "clock"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "tidy",
    "tidy:default": "done"
  }
}
```

### message

Sets the document body from a template.

Output ports: `default`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `template` | string | yes |  |

- `template` replaces the document payload. `{{operand}}` placeholders are substituted; operands are `doc.id`, `doc.props.NAME`, `process.props.NAME`, string literals and numbers. A missing property substitutes the empty string.

Example (`examples/flows/reference/message.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-message",
  "name": "Reference: message",
  "description": "Replace the payload from a template.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "body",
      "kind": "message",
      "config": {
        "template": "{\"orderId\": \"{{doc.props.orderId}}\"}"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "body",
    "body:default": "done"
  }
}
```

### setProperties

Sets document or process properties from CEL expressions.

Output ports: `default`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `properties` | array of object | yes | minItems 1 |

Each element of `properties`:

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | minLength 1 |
| `scope` | enum | no | one of `document`, `process` |
| `value` | string | yes |  |

- The schema description says the values are CEL expressions. In the engine each `value` is rendered with the same `{{operand}}` template mechanism as `message` (a plain string is stored as is).
- `scope` is `document` (default) or `process`. Process properties are shared by all documents of one execution. A name may be set only once per scope in one step (`setProperties.duplicate_name`).

Example (`examples/flows/reference/setProperties.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-setproperties",
  "name": "Reference: setProperties",
  "description": "Set document and process properties.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "props",
      "kind": "setProperties",
      "config": {
        "properties": [
          {
            "name": "orderId",
            "value": "{{doc.id}}"
          },
          {
            "name": "batch",
            "scope": "process",
            "value": "nightly"
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "props",
    "props:default": "done"
  }
}
```

### decision

Boolean CEL condition.

Output ports: `true`, `false`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cel` | string | yes | minLength 1 |

- Documents for which the condition is true leave by `true`, others by `false`. A condition error fails that document.
- The default evaluator (`BasicEvaluator`, used by the runtime deployer) supports only `true`/`false`, `!expr`, and `<operand> <op> <operand>` with `== != < <= > >=`; operands are string or number literals, `doc.id`, `doc.props.NAME`, `process.props.NAME`. Missing properties read as the empty string. Full CEL exists as `engine.CELEvaluator` (variables `doc.id`, `doc.props`, `process.props`) but is not selected by the runtime yet.

Example (`examples/flows/reference/decision.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-decision",
  "name": "Reference: decision",
  "description": "Split on a boolean condition.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "check",
      "kind": "decision",
      "config": {
        "cel": "doc.id != ''"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    },
    {
      "id": "rejected",
      "kind": "stop",
      "config": {
        "status": 404,
        "message": "not found"
      }
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "check",
    "check:true": "done",
    "check:false": "rejected"
  }
}
```

### branch

Runs paths sequentially.

Output ports: `1` .. `paths`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `paths` | integer | yes | >= 2; <= 25 |

- Every document set is copied to each path; paths run sequentially in order `1`..`paths`, not in parallel. Allowed range `paths`: 2 to 25.

Example (`examples/flows/reference/branch.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-branch",
  "name": "Reference: branch",
  "description": "Run two paths sequentially over copies of the set.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "fan",
      "kind": "branch",
      "config": {
        "paths": 2
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "first",
      "kind": "message",
      "config": {
        "template": "path one"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "second",
      "kind": "message",
      "config": {
        "template": "path two"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    },
    {
      "id": "done2",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "fan",
    "fan:1": "first",
    "fan:2": "second",
    "first:default": "done",
    "second:default": "done2"
  }
}
```

### route

Sends documents to the first matching route.

Output ports: one per route `id`, then `default`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `routes` | array of object | yes | minItems 1 |

Each element of `routes`:

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$` |
| `cel` | string | yes | minLength 1 |

- Each document goes to the first route whose condition is true, otherwise to `default`. Route ids must be unique and must not be `default` (`route.duplicate_id`, `route.reserved_id`). Conditions use the same evaluator as `decision`.

Example (`examples/flows/reference/route.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-route",
  "name": "Reference: route",
  "description": "Send each document to the first matching route.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "pick",
      "kind": "route",
      "config": {
        "routes": [
          {
            "id": "big",
            "cel": "doc.props.size == 'big'"
          },
          {
            "id": "small",
            "cel": "doc.props.size == 'small'"
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "big",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    },
    {
      "id": "small",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "pick",
    "pick:big": "big",
    "pick:small": "small",
    "pick:default": "done"
  }
}
```

### tryCatch

Runs a path and handles failures on a second path.

Output ports: `try`, `catch`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `retries` | integer | no | >= 0; <= 10 |

- Documents that fail anywhere on the `try` path (before the path ends) are retried up to `retries` times from their state at entry to the step, then sent down `catch` with the error in document properties `nurtuo.error.message`, `nurtuo.error.step` and `nurtuo.error.code`. There is no delay between retries.

Example (`examples/flows/reference/tryCatch.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-trycatch",
  "name": "Reference: tryCatch",
  "description": "Retry a failing path, then handle the failure.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "guard",
      "kind": "tryCatch",
      "config": {
        "retries": 2
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "risky",
      "kind": "connector",
      "config": {
        "connector": "http",
        "operation": "POST"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "recover",
      "kind": "setProperties",
      "config": {
        "properties": [
          {
            "name": "failed",
            "value": "true"
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    },
    {
      "id": "done2",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "guard",
    "guard:try": "risky",
    "guard:catch": "recover",
    "risky:default": "done",
    "recover:default": "done2"
  }
}
```

### processCall

Calls another flow by id.

Output ports: `default`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `flow` | string | yes | minLength 1 |
| `revision` | integer | no | >= 0 |

- Runs another flow with the current documents; returned documents continue on `default`. Process properties are copied into the called flow and not copied back. Nesting is limited to depth 16 (`processCall.depth` failure). A flow cannot call itself (`processCall.self_reference`); that the called flow exists is not checked by the validator and is resolved at run time.

Example (`examples/flows/reference/processCall.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-processcall",
  "name": "Reference: processCall",
  "description": "Call another flow by id.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "sub",
      "kind": "processCall",
      "config": {
        "flow": "ref-message",
        "revision": 1
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "sub",
    "sub:default": "done"
  }
}
```

### notify

Sends a notification.

Output ports: `default`.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | string | yes | minLength 1 |
| `template` | string | no |  |

- Runtime status: the schema accepts `notify` steps, but the engine has no step runner for them yet; a document reaching this step fails with code `no_runner`.

Example (`examples/flows/reference/notify.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-notify",
  "name": "Reference: notify",
  "description": "Send a notification.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "alert",
      "kind": "notify",
      "config": {
        "channel": "ops",
        "template": "Order {{doc.id}} processed"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "alert",
    "alert:default": "done"
  }
}
```

### stop

Ends the run.

Output ports: none (terminal).

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | integer | no | >= 100; <= 599 |
| `message` | string | no |  |

- Ends the whole execution. When the flow was started by the HTTP listener, `status` and `message` become the HTTP response; without `status` the listener answers with the returned documents (or 204).

Example (`examples/flows/reference/stop.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-stop",
  "name": "Reference: stop",
  "description": "End the run with a status.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "halt",
      "kind": "stop",
      "config": {
        "status": 422,
        "message": "rejected"
      }
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "halt"
  }
}
```

### returnDocuments

Returns the current documents to the caller.

Output ports: none (terminal).

No fields. `config` must be `{}`.

- Hands the documents that reach it to the caller (for the HTTP listener: the response body; one document is written as is, several as a JSON array).

Example (`examples/flows/reference/returnDocuments.flow.json`):

```json
{
  "schema": "nurtuo.flow/v1",
  "id": "ref-returndocuments",
  "name": "Reference: returnDocuments",
  "description": "Return the current documents to the caller.",
  "revision": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "start",
      "config": {
        "type": "manual"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "kind": "returnDocuments",
      "config": {}
    }
  ],
  "edges": {
    "start:default": "done"
  }
}
```
